name: Rock Island County, IL
findings: Rock Island County has 663 nonprofit organizations. 246 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 199 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rock Island County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
